-- Snapshot Vehicle Risk
WITH raw AS (
    SELECT * FROM "hpcl_ceg"."public"."tt_risk_score"
)

SELECT
    tt_number AS vehicle_id,
    risk_score AS current_risk_score,
    transporter_name,
    transporter_code,
    total_trips AS lifetime_trips
FROM raw

-- Cleaned and Renamed Truck Master
WITH raw AS (
    SELECT * FROM "hpcl_ceg"."public"."vts_truck_master"
)

SELECT
    truck_no AS vehicle_id,
    transporter_name,
    transporter_code,
    capacity_of_the_truck AS capacity,
    COALESCE(whether_truck_blacklisted, 'N') = 'Y' AS is_blacklisted,
    ownership_type,
    region,
    zone,
    engine_no,
    chassis_no,
    last_changed_date AS last_updated_at
FROM raw

-- Cleaned Ongoing Trips
WITH raw AS (
    SELECT * FROM "hpcl_ceg"."public"."vts_ongoing_trips"
)

SELECT
    id AS trip_pk,
    trip_id,
    tt_number AS vehicle_id,
    driver_name,
    transporter_name,
    invoice_no,
    vehicle_location AS current_location,
    violation_type AS current_violation_code,
    event_start_datetime AS trip_started_at,
    event_end_datetime AS trip_ended_at,
    region,
    zone,
    bu,
    sap_id
FROM raw

-- Cleaned Violation History
WITH raw AS (
    SELECT * FROM "hpcl_ceg"."public"."vts_alert_history"
),

truck_master AS (
    SELECT vehicle_id, transporter_name, transporter_code
    FROM "hpcl_ceg"."public"."stg_vts_truck_master"
)

SELECT
    r.id AS event_id,
    r.tl_number AS vehicle_id,
    tm.transporter_name,
    tm.transporter_code,
    r.vts_end_datetime AS event_at,
    r.total_trips,
    -- Pre-calculate the total violations metric
    (COALESCE(r.stoppage_violations_count, 0) + 
     COALESCE(r.route_deviation_count, 0) + 
     COALESCE(r.speed_violation_count, 0) + 
     COALESCE(r.night_driving_count, 0) + 
     COALESCE(r.device_offline_count, 0) + 
     COALESCE(r.device_tamper_count, 0) + 
     COALESCE(r.continuous_driving_count, 0) + 
     COALESCE(r.no_halt_zone_count, 0) + 
     COALESCE(r.main_supply_removal_count, 0)) AS total_violations_count,
    r.stoppage_violations_count,
    r.route_deviation_count,
    r.speed_violation_count,
    r.night_driving_count,
    r.violation_type AS violation_tags, -- original array
    r.region,
    r.bu,
    r.zone,
    r.location_name
FROM raw r
LEFT JOIN truck_master tm ON r.tl_number = tm.vehicle_id

-- The "Golden Record" for Al - combining Master info with current Risk and Violations
WITH vehicles AS (
    SELECT * FROM "hpcl_ceg"."public"."stg_vts_truck_master"
),

risk AS (
    SELECT * FROM "hpcl_ceg"."public"."stg_vts_vehicle_risk"
),

violations_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        vehicle_id,
        SUM(total_violations_count) AS lifetime_violations,
        MAX(event_at) AS last_violation_at
    FROM "hpcl_ceg"."public"."stg_vts_violation_history"
    GROUP BY 1
)

SELECT
    v.vehicle_id,
    v.transporter_name,
    v.region,
    v.zone,
    v.is_blacklisted,
    v.capacity,
    COALESCE(r.current_risk_score, 0) AS current_risk_score,
    COALESCE(vs.lifetime_violations, 0) AS total_violations_count,
    vs.last_violation_at
FROM vehicles v
LEFT JOIN risk r ON v.vehicle_id = r.vehicle_id
LEFT JOIN violations_summary vs ON v.vehicle_id = vs.vehicle_id

-- Transporter Performance Mart
WITH transporter_master AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT transporter_code, transporter_name
    FROM "hpcl_ceg"."public"."stg_vts_truck_master"
),

fleet_risk AS (
    SELECT * FROM "hpcl_ceg"."public"."transporter_risk_score"
),

violation_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        v.transporter_name,
        SUM(total_violations_count) AS fleet_violations,
        COUNT(DISTINCT vehicle_id) AS vehicle_count
    FROM "hpcl_ceg"."public"."stg_vts_violation_history" v
    GROUP BY 1
)

SELECT
    tm.transporter_name,
    tm.transporter_code,
    fr.risk_score AS current_fleet_risk,
    vt.fleet_violations,
    vt.vehicle_count,
    ROUND(CAST(vt.fleet_violations AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(vt.vehicle_count, 0), 2) AS violations_per_vehicle
FROM transporter_master tm
LEFT JOIN fleet_risk fr ON tm.transporter_code = fr.transporter_code
LEFT JOIN violation_totals vt ON tm.transporter_name = vt.transporter_name

-- AI ready Violation Trends
SELECT
    vehicle_id,
    region,
    zone,
    event_at::DATE AS violation_date,
    total_violations_count,
    stoppage_violations_count,
    route_deviation_count,
    speed_violation_count,
    night_driving_count
FROM "hpcl_ceg"."public"."stg_vts_violation_history"
